During the daytime, she can be seen teaching children hymns of the Order, while at night, she prays in front of a fountain. ==Quests and Events== ''(To Be Added) {{Quests and Events}} ==Idle Quotes== {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Julian:''' Through such a bright and shining grace... :'''Julian:''' Like the stars, we are piously united together... :'''Julian:''' Under your guidance, we rise from the waters... :'''Julian:''' Sacred and pure, reaching a place where the soul can breathe... {{Dialogue End}} ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(First interaction) :'''Julian:''' Alright, everyone, let's take a little break! :{{DIcon}} The children's voices are beautiful. ::'''Julian:''' Indeed! Children have the purest souls, and their voices ring clear—perfect for singing hymns. :{{DIcon}} I'd love to understand the meaning behind the lyrics. ::'''Julian:''' Absolutely. The hymns of the Order are themed around our teachings, especially our motto of "Salvation, Ascension, and Unity." :'''Julian:''' Once, the Sentinel's bright gaze pierced the darkness, leaving us out of endless wandering and binding us together as a people. :'''Julian:''' We drift on this world like plankton in the ocean... but it is the Sentinel who raises us up, teaching us to breathe once more... :'''Julian:''' In the end, we will find "Unity" again, hand in hand as we cross the final tide, reaching heaven's gate and receiving salvation... :{{DIcon}} Some of this is hard to follow... ::'''Julian:''' That's alright. As The Codex reminds us—every revelation is already there, waiting in our hearts. :{{DIcon}} But the hymn sounds beautiful. ::'''Julian:''' The hymns aim to awaken that truth. As The Codex reminds us—every revelation is already there, waiting in our hearts. :'''Julian:''' Still, I hear the Order is working on a new hymn. Personally, I feel this version tugs my heartstrings more... the new lyric lacks the rhythmic beauty of the original. :'''Julian:''' The new hymn leans heavily into "Unity" and expands on the interpretation of "The Deep"... probably to promote the Order's renown. :'''Julian:''' Yet no matter how rough the tides of this world may be, I believe that one day we'll see—behind us, we've always had wings of grace, ready to carry us forward. :'''Julian:''' Just as the old legends say, and as the Sentinel hopes: Young hearts, be bold—go forth and make miracles happen! ---- ;(Second interaction at 6:00 AM to 11:59 AM) :'''Julian:''' No matter how rough the tides of this world may be, one day we'll see—behind us, we've always had wings of grace, ready to carry us forward. :'''Julian:''' Just as the old legends say, and as the Sentinel hopes: Young hearts, be bold—go forth and make miracles happen! ---- ;(Second interaction at 12:00 PM to 12:59 PM) :'''Julian:''' Alright, everyone, let's take a little break! ---- ;(Missing condition) :'''Julian:''' Alright, everyone, let's take a little break! :'''Julian:''' We have a new member joining the choir today, so let's all make them feel welcome! {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Julian |zhs = 朱利安 |zht = 朱利安 |ja = ジュリアン |ko = 줄리안 |es = Julian |fr = Julian |de = Julian }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}}
